verdict.rationale: Lago is a billing platform with automation features (an AI billing agent, a Dunning Agent, and webhooks), so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no evidence of version history, review or approval flows, or rollback for any automation. API versioning (lago-docs-8) covers API compatibility rather than user automations, and webhook retries are not rollback, so neither counts.
